description: Get a limit order quote with expected output, expiry time, and a generated memo for executing the limit order. Limit orders execute when the target price is reached.

affiliate_bps.description: The affiliate fee in basis points (0-1000; protocol caps total affiliate fees at 1000 bps)

amount.description: The amount in base units (1e8 for most assets)

custom_ttl.description: Custom TTL in blocks for the limit order

destination.description: The destination address for the swap output

refund_address.description: The refund address if the swap fails

target_out.description: The limit price: minimum acceptable output amount in base units (1e8). The order executes only at this price or better

name: quote_limit
